style="--depth: 0;" class="astro-cxyftcne"><span style="--depth: 0;" class="astro-cxyftcne">Next steps</span></a></li></ul></nav></starlight-toc></div></div></div></aside><div class="main-pane class="content-panel astro-oil7k7jf"><div class="sl-container astro-oil7k7jf"><div class="sl-markdown-content"><div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h1"><h1 id="code-search-command-codesearch">Code Search Command (/codesearch)</h1><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#code-search-command-codesearch"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Code Search Command (/codesearch)”</span></a></div>
<p>Interactively search the code in your workspace from inside the TUI, without leaving your session or interrupting the agent.</p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="overview">Overview</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#overview"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Overview”</span></a></div>
<p>The <code dir="auto">/codesearch</code> command opens a fullscreen <strong>Code Search</strong> panel that runs a search across your current workspace and shows the matches grouped by file, with surrounding context and the matched text highlighted. It is handy for quickly locating a symbol, string, or pattern and then jumping straight to the file at the matching line.
<code dir="auto">/codesearch</code> directly queries your workspace and returns results instantly.</p>
<p>The command has two aliases: <code dir="auto">/cs</code> and <code dir="auto">/search</code>.</p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="running-a-search">Running a search</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#running-a-search"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Running a search”</span></a></div>
<ol>
<li>Type <code dir="auto">/codesearch</code> followed by your query in the prompt box.</li>
<li>Press <kbd>Enter</kbd>.</li>
</ol>
<pre class="astro-code astro-code-themes github-light github-dark" style="background-color:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e;color:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;" tabindex="0" data-language="text" dir="ltr"><code><span class="line"><span>/codesearch UserSession</span></span></code></pre>
<p>The Code Search panel opens with the results grouped by file. The header shows your query and the number of matches, and each match is displayed with one line of context above and below. The matched text is highlighted:</p>
<p><img src="/assets/image/docs/cli/codesearch-results.png" alt="The Code Search panel showing matches for a query grouped by file with highlighted results"></p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h3"><h3 id="navigation-and-controls">Navigation and controls</h3><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#navigation-and-controls"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Navigation and controls”</span></a></div>
<p>The panel is fully keyboard driven:</p>





























<table><thead><tr><th align="left">Key</th><th align="left">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="left"><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></td><td align="left">Move between individual matches</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><kbd>←</kbd> / <kbd>→</kbd></td><td align="left">Jump to the previous / next file group</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><kbd>Enter</kbd></td><td align="left">Open the highlighted result in the file viewer at the matching line</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>G</kbd></td><td align="left">Open the highlighted result in your external editor at the matching line</td></tr><tr><td align="left"><kbd>Esc</kbd></td><td align="left">Close the panel and return to the prompt</td></tr></tbody></table>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="query-syntax">Query syntax</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#query-syntax"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Query syntax”</span></a></div>
<p>By default, queries are interpreted as <strong>regular expressions</strong> and matching is case-insensitive unless your query contains an uppercase letter (smart case).</p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h3"><h3 id="literal-fixed-string-matching">Literal (fixed-string) matching</h3><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#literal-fixed-string-matching"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Literal (fixed-string) matching”</span></a></div>
<p>Add <code dir="auto">-F</code> (or <code dir="auto">--literal</code>) anywhere in the query to disable regex and match the text literally. This is useful when your query contains regex metacharacters such as <code dir="auto">.</code>, <code dir="auto">(</code>, or <code dir="auto">*</code>:</p>
<pre class="astro-code astro-code-themes github-light github-dark" style="background-color:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e;color:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;" tabindex="0" data-language="text" dir="ltr"><code><span class="line"><span>/codesearch -F map[string]*UserSession</span></span></code></pre>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h3"><h3 id="filtering-by-file-path">Filtering by file path</h3><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#filtering-by-file-path"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Filtering by file path”</span></a></div>
<p>Restrict a search to certain files with <code dir="auto">f:</code> (aliases <code dir="auto">file:</code> and <code dir="auto">path:</code>) followed by a glob. Prefix the filter with <code dir="auto">-</code> to <em>exclude</em> matching files instead:</p>
<pre class="astro-code astro-code-themes github-light github-dark" style="background-color:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e;color:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;" tabindex="0" data-language="text" dir="ltr"><code><span class="line"><span>/codesearch f:store.go Session</span></span></code></pre>
<pre class="astro-code astro-code-themes github-light github-dark" style="background-color:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e;color:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;" tabindex="0" data-language="text" dir="ltr"><code><span class="line"><span>/codesearch -f:*_test.go NewUserSession</span></span></code></pre>
<p><img src="/assets/image/docs/cli/codesearch-filter.png" alt="The Code Search panel scoped to a single file using an f: path filter"></p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h2"><h2 id="opening-a-file-and-commenting-on-lines">Opening a file and commenting on lines</h2><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#opening-a-file-and-commenting-on-lines"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Opening a file and commenting on lines”</span></a></div>
<p>Code Search is more than a viewer — you can open any result and give the agent precise, line-level feedback without leaving the CLI.</p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h3"><h3 id="open-a-result">Open a result</h3><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#open-a-result"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Open a result”</span></a></div>
<p>Highlight a match with <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open that file in the built-in file viewer, scrolled to the matching line. Use <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>G</kbd> instead to open it in your external editor.</p>
<p>Inside the file viewer, the footer shows the available actions:</p>
<pre class="astro-code astro-code-themes github-light github-dark" style="background-color:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e;color:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;" tabindex="0" data-language="text" dir="ltr"><code><span class="line"><span>↑/↓ scroll · pgup/pgdown page · shift+g bottom · g top · c comment · ctrl+g editor · / search</span></span></code></pre>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h3"><h3 id="comment-on-a-specific-line">Comment on a specific line</h3><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#comment-on-a-specific-line"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Comment on a specific line”</span></a></div>
<ol>
<li>Move the cursor (<kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd>) to the line you want to annotate.</li>
<li>Press <kbd>C</kbd> to open the inline comment editor for that line.</li>
<li>Type your note. Use <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd> (or <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>Enter</kbd>) for a new line, and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to save it.</li>
</ol>
<p>A saved comment is stored against that line and marked with a 💬 icon in the gutter. Repeat for as many lines as you like. To remove a comment, place the cursor on the line and press the delete key (<kbd>D</kbd>).</p>
<p><img src="/assets/image/docs/cli/codesearch-comment.png" alt="Leaving a line comment in the file viewer opened from Code Search"></p>
<div class="sl-heading-wrapper level-h3"><h3 id="send-your-comments-to-the-agent">Send your comments to the agent</h3><a class="sl-anchor-link" href="#send-your-comments-to-the-agent"><span aria-hidden="true" class="sl-anchor-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="m12.11 15.39-3.88 3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1-3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0-3.5l3.88-3.88a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-3.88 3.89a4.48 4.48 0 0 0 6.33 6.33l3.89-3.88a1 1 0 0 0-1.42-1.42m8.58-12.08a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-6.33 0l-3.89 3.88a1 1 0 1 0 1.42 1.42l3.88-3.88a2.52 2.52 0 0 1 3.5 0 2.47 2.47 0 0 1 0 3.5l-3.88 3.88a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42 1 1 0 0 0 1.42 0l3.88-3.89a4.49 4.49 0 0 0 0-6.33M8.83 15.17a1 1 0 0 0 .71.29 1 1 0 0 0 .71-.29l4.92-4.92a1 1 0 1 0-1.42-1.42l-4.92 4.92a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.42"></path></svg></span><span class="sr-only" data-pagefind-ignore>Section titled “Send your comments to the agent”</span></a></div>
<p>When you leave the file viewer with <kbd>Esc</kbd>, any pending comments are collected and the CLI asks whether to send them:</p>
<ul>
<li><kbd>Y</kbd> — <strong>send + close</strong>: your comments are delivered to the agent as your next message, formatted as <code dir="auto">&#x3C;file>:&#x3C;line>: &#x3C;comment></code> so the model knows exactly which lines you mean.</li>
<li><kbd>N</kbd> — <strong>discard + close</strong>: exit without sending.</li>
<li><kbd>Esc</kbd> — cancel and keep editing.</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="/assets/image/docs/cli/codesearch-comment-send.png" alt="Confirming whether to send unsent line comments to the agent"></p>
<p>This makes Code Search a fast way to find relevant code and hand the agent targeted, line-anchored instructions in a single flow.</p>
